notes.title: Desperate Place 1.2.0 Balance Adjustments
notes.content:

Based on your feedback, we've made a round of balance adjustments to certain values in the current version alongside the development of new content. We will continue to monitor feedback on various units and levels. Thank you for your support.

[h3][b]Monster Adjustments[/b][/h3]

[*] Adjusted Destroyer Subspecies HP 2200 → 2000
[*] Adjusted Whiplasher HP 360 → 320
[*] Adjusted Sieger Attack 260 → 240
[*] Adjusted the time interval for the Exterminator to hatch larvae
[/list]

notes.title: Desperate Place: Major Update "A New Start" Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Players,
It has been nearly two months since Desperate Place launched. During this time, we’ve received a great deal of valuable feedback and suggestions. We sincerely thank you for your support and enthusiasm![/h3][p]
[/p][h3][b]Foreword
[/b][/h3][p]Version 1.1.0 is a major update. We've made comprehensive changes to gameplay freedom, strategic depth, and control logic, aiming to provide a richer and more flexible gaming experience.

[/p][h3][b]Key Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p] [b]Greater Freedom[/b]
The defense tower system has undergone a major overhaul. Upon reaching level 2, players must choose a development branch. At level 3, exclusive traits will be unlocked to help tackle different challenges. Every choice significantly impacts your defensive strategy.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]New Buildings and Units[/b]
Two new types of factories have been added, producing a total of six new melee and ranged units. Each has unique characteristics. Players can control and command them directly to take charge of the battlefield.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Reworked Stages[/b]
All existing levels have been rebuilt with new construction points and layouts, offering more tactical flexibility. We highly recommend that veteran players start a new save to experience the changes.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Character Adjustments[/b]
Some previously overpowered characters have been rebalanced. For example, the Demolition Expert and the Commander now have new weapons. Passive skills of characters like the Engineer and the Arsonist have also been adjusted.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Tactical Robot Adjustments[/b]
With the addition of new units, tactical robots have also been rebalanced. Robots that previously had limited functions now offer more tactical benefits, such as healing and counterattack buffs for nearby units.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Monster Rework and Balancing[/b]
Monster traits have been extensively modified. Early monsters now have more distinct roles, and evolved variants are more specialized.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]New Fire Mode Options[/b]
In addition to the existing auto-fire mode, a manual fire mode has been added. Players can now manually target and eliminate higher-priority threats based on battlefield analysis.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]New Tactical Skills and Challenges[/b]
New tactical abilities and challenges have been designed for the newly introduced units, allowing players to maximize strategic gains in extreme situations and experience even tougher challenges.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]
[h3][b]Optimizations[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved localization for English, Korean, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese
[*] Launched limited localization tests for Spanish and Portuguese
[*] Enhanced graphical clarity and visual effects
[*] Improved pathfinding logic for monsters and units
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some monsters could get stuck on certain stages
[/list]

We will continue to monitor and improve the gaming experience. Thank you for your support and patience!
If you have any suggestions or feedback, please feel free to contact us.

Happy gaming!

—The Desperate Place Dev Team

notes.title: "A Fresh Start" Major Update – One Week Countdown
notes.content:
[p]It’s been over a month since [i]Desperate Place[/i] officially launched. We’re incredibly grateful for all the support and feedback from our players. In response, we’ll be bringing our first major update in just one week!    

Here’s a look at some of what’s coming:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Freedom[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191877/7b32f39263ca8088c6f0e7170264b920e682e5e5.jpg"][/img]Tower upgrades are no longer linear. When upgrading to Tier 2, you’ll choose a branch for your tower type. At Tier 3, each tower can gain a unique specialization to better handle future challenges. [/p][h3][b]
New Buildings[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191877/73bce5c0bdb425e3ae78a5525a1cf701451c4006.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Two new types of factories are being introduced, producing additional melee and ranged units—six unit types in total. Each unit has its own strengths, and players can choose and control them to take command of the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Combat Experience[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191877/0eca09acf4e42772968b10c2245795197d519d9c.jpg"][/img]We’ve made major adjustments to character and monster stats and traits, and added damage display for a fresher, more dynamic combat experience.  

……  
And that’s not all—we’re thrilled to share everything with you.
Mark the date—see you next week![/p]

notes.title: Future Update Roadmap Released
notes.content:
It’s been nearly a week since Desperate Place launched — heartfelt thanks to every Commander for your support and feedback! Your suggestions have been an invaluable source of direction and motivation for us.

To keep you informed about what’s coming next, we’ve compiled our development roadmap for the upcoming months — and now it’s officially live!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191877/1d83b30ed29ed2e59886542a5cd01daa14809cfe.jpg[/img]
We’re fully committed to further development, striving to make Desperate Place even better and deliver a superior gameplay experience.

None of this progress would be possible without your continued support and presence.
Thank you once again, Commanders — see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Desperate Place - Version 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thank you for your continued support and feedback! In this update, we’ve made the following optimizations and fixes:

[b]Optimization Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved English localization, enhancing translation accuracy and fluency
[*] Fixed issues with blurry text display
[*] Enhanced graphical clarity, improving visual effects
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]

[/list]

We will continue to monitor and improve the gameplay experience. Thank you for your support and patience! If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to contact us anytime.

notes.title: Desperate Place Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello players,

It has been three days since the launch of Desperate Place, and after receiving your valuable feedback, the development team has implemented the following updates:

[b]Major Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Greatly reduced the attack range of the Sieger, in order to alleviate negative gameplay experiences when defending against it with tower formations.
[*] Enhanced the range growth of various towers upon upgrading.
[*] Adjusted the positioning of certain defense towers on some maps.
[/list]

[b]Balance Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the HP of all towers to a certain extent.
[*] Adjusted the positioning of certain defense towers on some maps.
[*] Changed the tower type at the endpoint of the β-2 area.
[*] Extended the smoke duration of the T660 Deceiver-type robot.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial level could become stuck during progression.
[/list]

We would like to thank all the players who purchased Desperate Place for your support and constructive criticism. The development team remains committed to delivering a high-quality game experience. We're always listening and will continue to work hard to bring you even better gameplay.
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: "Desperate Place" Steam Next Fest Recap & Full Release Development Update
notes.content:
The recently concluded Steam Next Fest allowed Desperate Place to reach players from all over the world. We received a wealth of valuable feedback and suggestions, and we sincerely appreciate the support and enthusiasm from everyone!

As we continue developing future content, we've introduced a new build drone to assist the crew during the daytime strategy phase. This addition will provide a more intuitive and efficient way to view available construction options, enhancing the overall gameplay experience.

With the Next Fest coming to an end and the full release approaching, we will pause Demo updates to fully focus on polishing and refining the final version. Thank you for your understanding and support—we are committed to delivering the best possible experience for all players!

notes.title: Ver.0.6.1 Update Preview
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,
Hello everyone!

The demo version of Desperate Place has been available for some time now. During this period, we have received many thoughtful suggestions and feedback, including reports of issues and some fantastic creative ideas.

We are about to release an update to quickly address some of these issues, including:

[list]
[*] Leaderboard optimization
[*] Improved guidance for running
[*] Improved guidance for camera movement
[*] Optimized attack detection for the Arsonist
[*] Optimized attack detection for the Hunter, Defender, and Hacker
[*] Weapon balance adjustments for the Bomber
[*] Health adjustments for buildings (walls, machine gun towers, missile towers)
[*] Flame tower damage range adjustment
[*] Monster stat adjustments
[*] Adjusted attack speed, damage, and armor type for Sieger
[*] Slightly enhanced Boss difficulty
[*] Fixed a bug where Sieger incorrectly targeted the Energy Storage Unit
[*] Reduced waiting time before nightfall
[*] Optimized some text descriptions
[*] Improved buff effect display for the T700 Command Robot
[/list]

Additionally, we would like to extend a special thanks to Azure from our Discord channel for providing an extensive 2000-word suggestion on the game's development.

Thank you all for your support!
